note: What a server sends to tell everyone how far one seat has got through loading, and how it is holding up. A later report supersedes an earlier one, so losing one costs nothing. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id this is about.

fields.name: player
fields.note: Who occupies it.

fields.name: progress
fields.note: How far through loading it is, to 100.

fields.name: secondsLeft
fields.note: How much longer it is expected to take, in seconds.

bits.name: count
bits.note: How many times this has been reported.

bits.name: ping

bits.name: loaded
